description: Physical-axis correction from the 2026-07-23 pendant/base comparison. Camera optical +Z is aligned with the observed approach direction (UR base +X / ROS base_link -X), optical +Y is down (base_link -Z), and optical +X is image-right (base_link +Y). This remains provisional until the three-marker calibration is completed.

calibration_metrics.limitation: One physical approach direction plus the upright-image constraint fixes the axis convention, but a three-marker solve is still required for metrology-grade 6-DoF verification.
